articles.summary: Multi-year agreement covers a defined deployment of ReefIQ™ and specified LensAI™ capabilities MindWalk Holdings Corp. (“MindWalk”) (NASDAQ: HYFT), a Bio-Native AI company, today announced a multi-year agreement with Teva Pharmaceuticals Australia Pty Ltd (“Teva Australia”) to deploy ReefIQ™, MindWalk’s HYFT®-powered biological context layer with specified LensAI™ analytical capabilities, in support of a defined scope of antibody-discovery work. Teva Australia will use the AI capabilities to support discovery decisions based on generated predictions and accelerate antibody design optimization. MindWalk has been collaborating with Teva Australia since 2018. “We are pleased to continue our collaboration with Teva Australia through this defined deployment,” said Jennifer Bath, PhD, President and Chief Executive Officer of MindWalk.“Across the industry, the constraint in antibody discovery is no longer generating data. articles.title: MindWalk Announces Agreement with Teva Australia to Support Defined Antibody-Discovery Workflows
